name: Chesa Arella
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Chesa Arella is located in a quiet residential area in Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by extensive forests and mountains. The apartment offers a fully equipped kitchen as well as a modern bathroom. From the private terrace, guests have a view of the mountain landscape. The atmosphere is simple and functional. The accommodation is suitable for active holidaymakers and business travellers.
